bank.q: Differentiate checked and unchecked exceptions with an example of each.
bank.model: Checked are verified at compile time and must be handled or declared (IOException); unchecked occur at run time and handling is optional (NullPointerException).
throw triggers an exception inside a method; throws declares in the signature that the method may pass a checked exception to its caller.

bank.title: Mini project: Safe calculator
bank.brief: Write a method calc(String a, String op, String b) that parses two numbers and applies + - * /, handling NumberFormatException, division by zero and an unknown operator with meaningful messages.
